title: Sign-in is in the contract, and the contract is camelCase
description: Serves "Signing in is easy and safe."; Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need.". Split from JS-216 by D-20261127-sign-in-first: sign-in, sign-out and `/me` are declared with examples, and the contract is camelCase, before JS-184 serves anything.
acceptanceCriteria: Every field, query key and refusal member of `/jellyscale/v1/` is camelCase, served and declared, before JS-184 serves anything. The leaving operations (`playback-info`, `user-configuration`, `track-preferences`) keep their body fields and are marked as leaving at the cutover. The refusal envelope is `{reason, action}` (plus `retryAfterSeconds`, `detail`, `scope` where they apply) wherever it is sent. docs/api.md carries the preview exception and the `hideOtherAudio` example, as po-design.md C3 words them.

The contract declares `POST /sign-in`, `POST /sign-out` and `GET /me`. For each it gives the request, the answer, who may call it and its reasons: `credentials-not-accepted` 401 at sign-in, `too-many-tries` 429 with `retryAfterSeconds` (at most 900) and `scope` (`name`, `device` or `network`), `account-off` 403, `invalid-body` 400, `unauthorized` 401. Each has at least one example answer Octave can mock against. The sign-in and `/me` answers name the account, the profile and the device, with different ids in every example. The contract declares a token sent as `Authorization: Bearer` beside today's spellings.
The conformance check of JS-183 passes on the whole contract.

A from:jellyscale issue reaches Octave before anything in it is served (D-132). It names every renamed field, supersedes octave#391's `Reason` and `Action`, and says what the first stop lets Octave test.
notes: Casing is D-20261127-camelcase-contract (criterion 1). The preview exception is D-20261127-preview-names-may-change. docs/api.md, written by this task, in those words: after "A break is `v2`, served beside v1.", add: "The rule binds stable operations. An operation in `preview` or `declared` may rename, remove or change a field, query key or envelope member before it is marked stable, and only by a change that reaches Octave as a from:jellyscale issue naming each change before it is served (D-132). An operation is never changed this way after it is stable. The leaving operations are not renamed; they go at the cutover." Also replace "(`HideOtherAudio`, not `hideotheraudio`)" with "(`hideOtherAudio`, not `hideotheraudio`)".
